class.name: SuperpositionConfig
class.brief_description: Reusable Superposition property schema and update policy.
class.description: Reusable property schema and reliable gameplay update policy for [Superposition]. Replicate checkboxes create typed rules automatically; save the resource and use matching configurations on all peers. Quantization runs before dirty detection, scheduling and optional byte-delta encoding. Prediction, scene lifecycle and RPCs are supplied by separate Superposition components.

members.member: Automatic (0) polls selected properties. Pushed (1) skips target capture until [method Superposition.mark_dirty] is called. Baselines and schema/session changes still capture automatically.

Enables optional native byte-run patches against each peer's acknowledged full state. Acknowledgment, not merely queueing a revision, advances the baseline. Late join, reconnect and interest re-entry receive a full baseline; size changes, nonbeneficial patches and exhausted snapshot capacity also use full state. Acknowledged and pending snapshot storage is bounded to 1 MiB per peer. This optimizes serialized quantized snapshots, not individual semantic fields. Native wire version 3 peers are required; the default preserves full-state behavior.
Visible objects leave at Radius + Hysteresis; hidden objects re-enter at Radius. Prevents interest boundary churn.
Radius around a Node3D target used for explicitly supplied observer positions. Zero disables spatial relevance filtering. Unspecified observers remain visible.
Native scheduling service weight from 1 to 16. Higher values favor this object under a peer update budget; waiting lower-priority flows retain their scheduling position.
One to 32 enabled typed properties, with no duplicate names. At most 32 total rules.
Server capture and client application rate from 1 to 30 Hz. Catch-up does not emit bursts.
